In detail

Borgo Venezia, a dense residential quarter north-east of the walls. The one specific finding is via Fiumicello, added to the Prefettura's monitored zone rosse alongside via Barana after reported urban decay and loitering. Otherwise unremarkable, and not somewhere visitors have reason to be after dark.
